findings.F1: The tested grading is absent inside the bottom half of the range. On choppy calm 5-day grid cases with the close below the middle, the slope of the excess return on range position is -1.99 % (t -0.58, 90 cases, 58 days), and the correlation of position with excess return is -0.064. That matches step 5's slope t of -0.68 on 281 cases: closes nearer the low are not followed by larger falls than closes just below the middle.
findings.F2: The bottom half does fall as a block, but not in a graded way. In choppy calm, the bottom bucket returns -3.19 % (t -2.06, n 18), the lower-middle bucket -1.51 % (t -1.11, n 40) and the middle bucket -2.77 % (t -2.73, n 52). Step 5's supporting mean is -0.96 % and passes. The forecast quartiles show no order: -3.10 %, -1.74 %, -1.65 %, -3.94 % from most negative to least negative.
findings.F3: The gradient that does exist runs across the whole 20-day range, in the continuation direction: the higher the close, the higher the next 5 days' excess return. On choppy calm grid bars the full-range slope is +3.89 % per unit of position (t 2.01, 178 cases, 92 days). On all bars it is +2.78 % (t 2.42, 1,364 cases, 256 days). It is positive on every coin, with t from 1.54 to 2.01.
findings.F4: Most of this full-range gradient comes from the upper end. Outside choppy calm, the top bucket returns +3.28 % (t 3.39, n 206); the upper-half slope is +3.41 % (t 1.66), against -1.20 % (t -0.38) for the lower half.
findings.F5: The continuation gradient is strongest when the trend is choppy. With the 60-day trend recomputed inside each window, the slope is +8.62 % (t 2.39, 125 cases, 65 days) in choppy markets, +5.78 % (t 2.40) in rising markets and +2.03 % (t 0.83) in falling markets.
findings.F6: The effect is uneven over the years, so the test was drowned partly by period. In choppy calm, the yearly slopes are -2.19 % (2018), -2.13 % (2019), +1.66 % (2020) and +13.8 % (2021, t 2.78). The bottom-half mean is -6.29 % in 2018 but +0.90 % in 2020.

ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, the higher a coin's close sits within its 20-day high-low range, the larger its rise over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In quiet sideways markets, a trader has a reason to lean long on closes high in the recent range and short on closes low in it, the more so the farther from the opposite edge, rather than fading the edges.
ideas.name: calm range position continues

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the higher a coin's close sits within its 20-day high-low range, the larger its rise over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: When a coin has gone sideways for two months, a trader should follow where its close sits in the recent range rather than bet on a return to the middle.
ideas.name: choppy range position continues
